newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-JARDEL NAMED IN BRAZIL SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JARDEL NAMED IN BRAZIL SQUAD.

text.p: Striker Jardel, who has played only five mintues of international soccer, was included in the Brazil squad on Tuesday for next month's friendly at home against Chile.
Jardel was one of nine foreign-based players named by coach Mario Zagallo for the April 2 match in the capital Brasilia.
His only previous experience in the famous gold shirt was when he came on as a substitute in a friendly away to the Netherlands last year.
Jardel, whose main strength is in the air, is considered ungamely by Brazilian standards but he has proved extremly effective for both Gremio and his current club, Porto of Portugal.
He is expected to be used as a substitute for either Ronaldo or Romario during the game.
Barcelona's Ronaldo was also named, as was midfielder Juninho, despite the fact that his club Middlesbrough are bottom of the English premiership.
The other foreigners named were defenders Aldair, Cesar Prates and Roberto Carlos and midfielders Ze Roberto and Mauro Silva and Leonardo.
The home-based players will be named next week.
